note: PROVISIONAL Greek -> English glossary for translating ΒαΔ 3-1/2025 ΔΑΕ (3-01) and ΠΔ 29/2020 into English for the retrieval library. It SUPPLEMENTS D:\FDMS\specs\vocabulary-el-en.json, which stays authoritative: if a Greek form is in the vocabulary, the vocabulary's `en` wins and this file is ignored for it. Use exactly like the vocabulary: wherever the Greek has `el` or any `el_forms` (any case, any accent), write `en` verbatim; first time in a chunk write `en (el)`, afterwards only `en`. Abbreviations: the English expansion in `en` is what goes into the text; `en_abbr` may be used after the first mention only when given. Latin-letter abbreviations from Annex Γ are already English in the source: keep them as written and use `en` only in the `en (abbr)` first mention. Codes (Σ-20, ΠΡ-7α, ΣΧΑ-6, ΕΠ-1, ΔΠ-1(1), SIM-ΔΑ, MIS) and document designators (ΚΠΑ Β-6/ΓΕΑ, ΠαΔ 6-1/ΓΕΑ, ΒαΔ 0-5/ΑΤΑ, ΓΕΑ/Β2, ΔΑΕ/Β6) are copied byte for byte. `confidence: low` = best guess, check before relying on it. `vocabulary_form_additions` = spellings in the books that belong to an EXISTING vocabulary term (for the vocabulary owner to add). `vocabulary_conflicts` = places where applying the vocabulary literally would mistranslate these two books; translators follow the vocabulary until the owner decides, but should read these. Owner rulings of 07/11/2026 applied (πτέρυγας = Wing; εκπαιδευόμενος = Student Pilot). Aligned 07/11 with vocabulary 2026-11-07c (FDMS § 7): terms now in the vocabulary removed; FDMS § 7.4 changes applied; haf_abbrev rule applied to abbreviations the sources do not expand. The vocabulary always wins.
